name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck: orders, kitchen
promotionalText: Accept orders in advance, protect the kitchen from too many orders and keep serving when the signal disappears. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers order in advance and choose a collection time. Your staff see all orders on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can prepare, then mark them as ready and collected.

NEVER PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN'T MEET
Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a collection time is taken, customers can't choose it, so the queue matches the kitchen's capacity.

TAKE ORDERS ON THE SPOT
Add on-the-spot orders on the same screen as orders placed in advance, so the kitchen works from one queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what to prepare now, what comes next and what is ready, with an alert when an order needs starting.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect a kitchen receipt printer via Bluetooth or the local network, and order tickets will print automatically.

KEEP SERVING WHEN THE SIGNAL DISAPPEARS
Switch on offline protection and, if the connection breaks, ordering in advance stops so nobody places an order you wouldn't see. Orders you take on the device are saved and sync when you are connected again.

MADE FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Let the screen stay on during service, get a notification when an order is waiting for confirmation, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Set up your events and locations once and take orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is intended for food truck operators and their staff. To sign in you need a HatchGrab account.
whatsNew:
